verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook has a built-in AI assistant. It answers questions grounded in your sources, and you can hand it concrete work: reports (FAQ, study guide, briefing, or custom), slide decks, audio/video overviews, mind maps, flashcards, quizzes and infographics. You can also tune its persona or role and queue generations for later when you hit AI limits. However, the delegation shown is single-shot artifact generation rather than autonomous multi-step agentic work, and one user called the interactive audio mode 'janky'. Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous multi-step task execution or actions beyond content generation, and stronger independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation.
